title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 13 章‧犬（上）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
kat tat dãma speñtô-mainyava aêtanghãm
dâmanãm ýôi heñti speñtahe
mainyêush dãma dâtem vîspem paiti ushånghem
â hû vaxshat hazangraja angrô mainyush paiti-jasaiti.
segments.en:
Which is the good creature among the creatures of the Good
Spirit that from midnight till the sun is up goes and kills
thousands of the creatures of the Evil Spirit?
segments.zh: 善靈的造物中，哪一種是好的造物，從午夜至太陽升起，前往殺死惡靈的千千萬萬造物的？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå spânem sîzhdrem
urvîsarem ýim vanghâparem ýim mashyâka
avi duzhvacanghô duzhakem nãma aojaite, aêtat
tat dãma speñtô-mainyava aêtanghãm
dâmanãm ýôi heñti speñtahe
mainyêush dãma dâtem vîspem paiti ushånghem
â hû vaxshat hazangraja angrô-mainyush paiti-jasaiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The dog with the prickly back, with
the long and thin muzzle, the dog Vanghapara, which
evil-speaking people call the Duzaka; this is the good creature
among the creatures of the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP] that from midnight till
the sun is up goes and kills thousands of the creatures of the
Evil Spirit.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「具有刺背的狗，具有長而細吻的狗，名叫王狗的狗，惡言的人稱之為杜扎卡狗；這就是善靈（斯彭塔‧曼紐）的造物中那種好的造物，從午夜至太陽升起，前往殺死惡靈的千千萬萬造物的。」

segments.orig:
ýasca dim janat spitama zarathushtra spânem sîzhdrem
urvîsarem ýim vanghâparem ýim mashyâka
avi duzhvacanghô duzhakem nãma aojaite nava-naptyaêcit
hê urvânem para-mereñcaite ýaêshãm
anghat duzhâpîm cinvat-peretûm ýô
nôit jvô sraoshyãm uzverezyeiti.
segments.en:
'And whosoever, O Zarathushtra! shall kill the dog with the
prickly back, with the long and thin muzzle, the dog Vanghapara,
which evil-speaking people call the Duzaka, kills his own soul
for nine generations, nor shall he find a way over the Chinwad
bridge, unless he has, while alive, atoned for his sin.'
segments.zh: 「凡是，查拉圖斯特拉啊！殺死具有刺背的狗，具有長而細吻的狗，名叫王狗的狗，惡言的人稱之為杜扎卡狗的人，他的靈魂在九代之內被殺死，他也不能在活著時贖罪的情況下，找到一條越過裁判之橋的道路。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô janat spânem sîzhdrem
urvîsarem ýim vanghâparem ýim mashyâka
avi duzhvacanghô duzhakem nãma aojaite kâ hê
asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hazangrem
upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya hazangrem
sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man kill
the dog with the prickly back, with the long and thin muzzle, the
dog Vanghapara, which evil-speaking people call the Duzaka, what
is the penalty that he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'A thousand stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, a thousand stripes with the Sraosho-charana.
 
 Ib.
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人殺死具有刺背的狗，具有長而細吻的狗，名叫王狗的狗，惡言的人稱之為杜扎卡狗，他應當支付什麼刑罰？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「用馬鞭施加一千鞭，用斯勞沙鞭施加一千鞭。」

segments.orig:
kat tat dãma angrô-mainyava aêtanghãm
dâmanãm ýôi heñti angrahe mainyêush
dãma dâtem vîspem paiti ushånghem â
hû vaxshat hazangraja speñtô-mainyûm
paiti-jasaiti.
segments.en:
Which is the evil creature among the creatures of the Evil
Spirit that from midnight till the sun is up goes and kills
thousands of the creatures of the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP]?
segments.zh: 惡靈的造物中，哪一種是惡的造物，從午夜至太陽升起，前往殺死善靈（斯彭塔‧曼紐）的千千萬萬造物的？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, daêum ýim
zairimyangurem nãma spitama zarathushtra ýim mashyâka
avi duzhvacanghô zairimyâkem nãma aojaite,
aêtat tat dãma angrô-mainyava aêtanghãm
dâmanãm ýôi heñti angrahe mainyêush
dãma dâtem vîspem paiti ushånghem â
hû vaxshat hazangraja speñtô-mainyûm
paiti-jasaiti.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The daeva Zairimyangura, which
evil-speaking people call the Zairimyaka, this is the evil
creature among the creatures of the Evil Spirit that from
midnight till the sun is up goes and kills thousands of the
creatures of the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP].
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「迭瓦札伊里姆揚古拉，惡言的人稱之為札伊里姆亞卡，這就是惡靈的造物中那種惡的造物，從午夜至太陽升起，前往殺死善靈（斯彭塔‧曼紐）的千千萬萬造物的。」

segments.orig:
ýasca dim janat spitama zarathushtra daêum ýim
zairimyangurem ýim mashyâka avi duzhvacanghô
zairimyâkem nãma aojaite patitem hê manô
anghat patitem vacô patitem shyaothnem uzvarshtem hê
manô anghat uzvarshtem vacô uzvarshtem shyaothnem!
segments.en:
'And whosoever, O Zarathushtra! shall kill the daeva
Zairimyangura, which evil-speaking people call the Zairimyaka,
his sins in thought, word, and deed are redeemed as they would be
by a Patet; his sins in thought, word, and deed are atoned for.
segments.zh: 「凡是，查拉圖斯特拉啊！殺死迭瓦札伊里姆揚古拉，惡言的人稱之為札伊里姆亞卡的人，他的思想、言語、行為中的罪孽得以贖救，如同由懺悔禮所為者一般；他的思想、言語、行為中的罪孽得以贖罪。」

segments.orig:
ýô aêtaêshãm sûnãm
jaiñti ýim pasush-haurvãmca vishhaurvãmca
vohunazgãmca draxtô-hunaranãmca xraosyô-taraca
nô ahmât voyô-taraca hvô urva parâiti
parô-asnâi anguhe
ýatha vehrkô vayôi tûite
dramne barezishte razûire.
segments.en:
'Whosoever shall smite either a shepherd's dog, or a
house-dog, or a Vohunazga dog, or a trained dog,
his soul when passing to the other world, shall fly
howling louder and more sorely grieved than the sheep does in the
lofty forest where the wolf ranges.
segments.zh: 「凡是打擊牧羊狗、家犬、沃胡納茲卡狗或訓練狗中的任何一種的人，他的靈魂在經向另一世界時，會尖叫著飛去，比在高大的森林中狼徘徊的地方的羊所做的更大聲更深深地悲慘。」

segments.orig:
nôit hê anyô urva haom urvânem paiti
irista bãzaiti xraosyâca voyaca anguhe naêdha
spâna peshu-pâna paiti irista bãzaiti xraosyâca
voyaca anguhe.
segments.en:
'No soul will come and meet his departing soul and help it,
howling and grieved in the other world; nor will the dogs that
keep the [Chinwad] bridge help his departing soul howling and
grieved in the other world.
segments.zh: 沒有靈魂會來相迎他的離魂，在彼世哀號悲慟地幫助它；守護〔裁判之橋〕的狗也不會幫助他的離魂在彼世哀號悲慟。

segments.orig:
ýô sûne pishtrem jaiñti ýim
pasush-haurve us vâ hê gaoshem thweresaiti apa vâ
hê paidhyãm kereñtaiti ýase-tat paiti
avå gaêthå tâyush vâ vehrkô
vâ apaiti-busti haca gaêthâbyô para-baraiti
dasa adhât paiti afshê cikayat, cikayat sûnahe
raêshô baodhô-varshtahe cithaya.
segments.en:
'If a man shall smite a shepherd's dog so that it becomes
unfit for work, if he shall cut off its ear or its paw, and
thereupon a thief or a wolf break in and carry away [sheep] from
the fold, without the dog giving any warning, the man shall pay
for the loss, and he shall pay for the wound of the dog as for
wilful wounding.
segments.zh: 若一人打擊牧羊人的狗，致其不堪工作，若他割斷其耳或其爪，隨後有賊或狼闖入並從羊圈帶走〔羊群〕，狗不發出任何警告，該人應賠償損失，並應如同故意傷害般賠償狗的傷口。

segments.orig:
ýô sûne pishtrem jaiñti ýim
vîsh-haurve us vâ hê gaoshem thweresaiti apa
vâ hê paidhyãm kereñtaiti ýase-tat
paiti avå vîsô tâyush vâ vehrkô
vâ apaiti-busti haca vîzhibyô para-baraiti dasa
adhât paiti afshê cikayat, cikayat sûnahe raêshô
baodhô-varshtahe cithaya.
segments.en:
'If a man shall smite a house-dog so that it becomes unfit
for work, if he shall cut off its ear or its paw, and thereupon a
thief or a wolf break in and carry away [anything] from the
house, without the dog giving any warning, the man shall pay for
the loss, and he shall pay for the wound of the dog as for wilful
wounding.'
segments.zh: 若一人打擊家犬，致其不堪工作，若他割斷其耳或其爪，隨後有賊或狼闖入並從房舍帶走〔任何東西〕，狗不發出任何警告，該人應賠償損失，並應如同故意傷害般賠償狗的傷口。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem jaiñti
ýim pasush-haurum frazâbaodhanghem snathem vîkeret-ushtânem
kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
ashta sata upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe
ashtraya ashta sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall smite a shepherd's dog, so that it gives up the ghost and
the soul parts from the body, what is the penalty that he shall
pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Eight hundred stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, eight hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人打擊牧羊人的狗，致其氣絕身亡、靈魂離體，他應納何罰？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭八百下，以斯勞沙鞭八百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem jaiñti
ýim vish-haurum frazâbaodhanghem snathem vîkeret-ushtânem
kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
hapta sata upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe
ashtraya hapta sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall smite a house-dog so that it gives up the ghost and the
soul parts from the body, what is the penalty that he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered; 'Seven hundred stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, seven hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人打擊家犬，致其氣絕身亡、靈魂離體，他應納何罰？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭七百下，以斯勞沙鞭七百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem jaiñti
ýim vohunazgem frazâbaodhanghem snathem vîkeret-ushtânem
kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
xshvash sata....
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall smite a Vohunazga dog so that it gives up the ghost and
the soul parts from the body, what is the penalty that he shall
pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Six hundred stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, six hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人打擊沃胡納茲加犬，致其氣絕身亡、靈魂離體，他應納何罰？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭六百下，以斯勞沙鞭六百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem jaiñti
ýim taurunem frazâbaodhanghem snathem vîkeret-ushtânem
kâ hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
pañca sata....
segments.en:
O Maker of tlie material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall smite a Tauruna dog so that it gives up the ghost and the
soul parts from the body, what is the penalty that he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Five hundred stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, five hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人打擊陶魯納犬，致其氣絕身亡、靈魂離體，他應納何罰？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭五百下，以斯勞沙鞭五百下。」

segments.orig:
hâu jazhâush hâu vîzâush hâu
sukurenahe hâu urupish tizhi-dâtahe hâu raopish
ýaonô-hvatahe hâu vîspanãm speñtô-mainyavanãm
spacithranãm anya udra upâpa!
segments.en:
'This is the penalty for the murder of a
Jazhu dog, of a Vizu dog, of a porcupine dog,
of a sharptoothed weasel, of a swift-running fox; this
is the penalty for the murder of any of the creatures
of the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu] belonging to the dog kind,
except the water-dog.'
segments.zh: 此乃雅祖犬之謀殺罰、維祖犬之謀殺罰、豪豬犬之謀殺罰、尖牙鼬鼠之謀殺罰、疾馳狐之謀殺罰；此乃屬於善靈〔斯彭塔‧曼紐〕的犬類生物中任何一種之謀殺罰，除水犬外。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... dva asti spâ pasush-haurvô dâityô-gâtush,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô ýûjyastîm
haca gaêthâbyô parâiti sraêshemnô
tâyûsh vehrkemca.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What is the
place of the shepherd's dog?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He comes and goes a Yujyesti round
about the fold, watching for the thief and the wolf.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！牧羊人的犬的位置是什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「牠繞著羊圈往來，距離為一尤傑斯提，守望著盜賊和狼。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kva asti spâ vish-haurvô dâityô-gâtush,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô hâthrô-masanghem
adhwanem haca vîzhibyô parâiti sraêshemnô
tâyûsh vehrkemca.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What is the
place of the house-dog?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He comes and goes a Hathra round
about the house, watching for the thief and the wolf.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！家犬的位置是什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「牠繞著房舍往來，距離為一哈特拉，守望著盜賊和狼。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kva asti spâ vohunazgô dâityô-gâtush,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýô naêcim
isaiti hunaranãm tanuye isaite thrâthrem!
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What is the
place of the Vohunazga dog?.
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He claims none of those talents, and
only seeks for his subsistence.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！沃胡納茲加犬的位置是什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「牠不要求那些才能，只尋求自己的糊口。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim pasush-haurum cvat aêtaêshãm
shyaothnanãm âstâraiti, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, ýatha aêtahmi anghvô ýat
astvaiñti fratemô-nmânahe nmânô-paitîm
paiti tarô-pithwem daithyât atha âstryeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man give
bad food to a shepherd's dog, of what sin does he make himself
guilty?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He makes himself guilty of the same
guilt as though he should serve bad food to a master of a house
of the first rank.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一人給牧羊人的犬劣質的食物，他造成什麼罪孽？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他造成的罪孽，如同他向第一等級的家主人獻上劣質的食物一般。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim vishhaurum cvat aêtaêshãm
shyaothnanãm âstâraiti, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, ýatha aêtahmi anghvô ýat
astvaiñti madhemô-nmânahe nmânô-paitîm
paiti tarô-pithwem daithyât atha âstryeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man give
bad food to a house-dog, of what sin does he make himself guilty?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He makes himself guilty of the same
guilt as though he should serve bad food to a master of a house
of middle rank.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一人給家犬劣質的食物，他造成什麼罪孽？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他造成的罪孽，如同他向中等級的家主人獻上劣質的食物一般。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim vohunazgem cvat aêtaêshãm
shyaothnanãm âstâraiti, âat mraot ahurô
mazdå, narem bôit idha ashavanem jaseñti ahmya
nmâne mat avabyô daxshtâbyô ýatha
âthrava paiti tarô-pithwem daithyât atha âstryeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man give
bad food to a Vohunazga dog, of what sin does he make himself
guilty?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He makes himself guilty of the same
guilt as though he should serve bad food to a holy man, who
should come to his house in the character of a priest.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一人給沃胡納茲加犬劣質的食物，他造成什麼罪孽？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他造成的罪孽，如同他向一位聖者獻上劣質的食物一般，那位聖者以祭司的身份來到他的家。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim taurunem cvat aêtaêshãm shyaothnanãm
âstâraiti, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
ýatha aêtahmi anghvô ýat astvaiñti
aperenâyûkem dahmô-keretem shyaothnâvarezem
verezyât shyaothnem paiti tarô-pithwem daithyât
atha âstryeiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man give
bad food to a Tauruna dog, of what sin does he make himself
guilty?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He makes himself guilty of the same
guilt as though he should serve bad food to a young man, born of
pious parents, and who can already answer for his deeds.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一人給陶魯納犬劣質的食物，他造成什麼罪孽？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他造成的罪孽，如同他向一位生自虔誠雙親、已能為自己的行為負責的年輕人獻上劣質的食物一般。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim pasush-haurum kâ hê asti citha, âat
mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti peshô-tanuye
duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe
ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall give bad food to a shepherd's dog, what is the penalty that
he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He is a Peshotanu: two hundred
stripes with the Aspahe-astra, two hundred stripes with the
Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一人給牧羊人的犬劣質的食物，他須償付的懲罰是什麼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他是佩紹坦努罪：用馬鞭二百鞭，用斯勞沙鞭二百鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim vishhaurum kâ hê asti citha, âat
mraot ahurô mazdå, navaitîm upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya navaitîm sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall give bad food to a house-dog, what is the penalty that he
shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Ninety stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
ninety stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若人給家犬餵食不良的食物，他應當繳納什麼罰金？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭鞭打九十下，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打九十下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim vohunazgem kâ hê asti citha, âat
mraot ahurô mazdå, haptâitîm upâzananãm....
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall give bad food to a Vohunazga dog, what is the penalty that
he shall pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Seventy stripes with the
Aspahe-astra, seventy stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若人給沃呼納茲加犬餵食不良的食物，他應當繳納什麼罰金？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭鞭打七十下，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打七十下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýô spânem tarô-pithwem
daste ýim taurunem kâ hê asti citha, âat
mraot ahurô mazdå, pañcâsatem upâzananãm....
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man
shall give bad food to a Tauruna dog, what is the penalty that he
shall pay?
Ahura Mazda ansvvered: 'Fifty stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
fifty stripes with the Sraosho-charana.
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若人給陶魯納犬餵食不良的食物，他應當繳納什麼罰金？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「以馬鞭鞭打五十下，以斯勞沙鞭鞭打五十下。」

segments.orig:
aêtem zî aêtahmi anghvô ýat
astvaiñti spitama zarathushtra speñtahe mainyêush
dâmanãm âsishtem zaurvânem upâiti
ýat spânô ýôi hishteñte
ahvarô upa hvareñtem parô spasânô
eviñdânô parô xshvisca âzûitishca
gêush mat baratu hvarethanãm sûnahe aêvahe
dâityô-pithwem.
segments.en:
'For in this material world, O Spitama Zarathushtra! it is
the dog, of all the creatures of the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu], that most
quickly decays into age, while not eating near eating people, and
watching goods none of which it receives. Bring ye unto him milk
and fat with meat; this is the right food for the dog.'
segments.zh: 「在這物質世界中，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！狗在善靈的所有受造物中，乃最迅速地衰朽入老，儘管它不與進食的人相近而食，且守望著它所不能獲得的任何貨物。你們應當帶給它乳汁、脂肪及肉；這就是狗的正確食物。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýat ahmi nmâne ýat mâzdayasnôish
spâ avacå vâ bavat adhâityô-xratush
kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If there be
in the house of a worshipper of Mazda a mad dog that bites
without barking, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若馬茲達教徒之家有狂犬無聲而咬人，馬茲達教徒應當為之奈何？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ava hê barayen
tâshtem dâuru upa-tãm manaothrîm stamanem
hê adhât nyâzayen ishti-masô xraozhdvahe
bish aêtavatô varedvahe.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall put a wooden collar around
his neck, and they shall tie thereto a muzzle, an asti thick if
the wood be hard, two astis thick if it be soft. To that collar
they shall tie it; by the two sides of the collar they shall tie
it.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「彼等應於其頸套以木圈，並繫以口罩，若木堅硬則厚一阿希，若木柔軟則厚二阿希。彼等應將之繫於該木圈；由木圈兩側將之繫牢。」

segments.orig:
aêtahmâtcit nidarezayen frâ-hîmcit
nidarezayen ýezi nôit spâ avacå vâ
adhâityô-xratush pasûm vâ narem vâ
raêshyât para hê irishiñtô raêshem
cikayat baodhô-varshtahe cithaya.
segments.en:
'If they shall not do so, and the mad dog that bites without
barking, smite a sheep or wound a man, the dog shall pay for the
wound of the wounded as for wilful murder.
segments.zh: 「若彼等不為此，狂犬無聲而咬人，擊傷綿羊或傷害人類，該犬應為所傷者之傷償如故意殺人。」

segments.orig:
paoirîm pasûm avakhnât paoirîm narem
raêshyât dashinem hê gaoshem upa-thweresayen
bitîm pasûm avakhnât bitîm narem raêshyât
hôyum hê gaoshem upa-thweresayen.
segments.en:
'If the dog shall smite a sheep or wound a man, they shall
cut off his right ear.
'If he shall smite another sheep or wound another man, they
shall cut off his left ear.
segments.zh:
「若犬擊傷綿羊或傷害人類，彼等應割去其右耳。
若其擊傷另一綿羊或傷害另一人，彼等應割去其左耳。」

segments.orig:
thritîm pasûm avakhnât thritîm narem
raêshyât dashinem hê paidhyãm upa-kereñtayen
tûirîm pasûm avakhnât tûirîm
narem raêshyât haoyãm hê paidhyãm
upa-kereñtayen.
segments.en:
'If he shall smite a third sheep or wound a third man, they
shall make a cut in his right foot. If he shall smite a fourth
sheep or wound a fourth man, they shall make a cut in his left
foot.
segments.zh: 『若他第三次打擊羊群或傷害一個人，他們應在其右足上割一刀。若他第四次打擊羊群或傷害一個人，他們應在其左足上割一刀。」

segments.orig:
puxdhem pasûm avakhnât puxdhem narem raêshyât
dumemcit hê upa-thweresayen, aêtahmâtcit nidarezayen
... cithaya.
segments.en:
'If he shall for the fifth time smite a sheep or wound a
man, they shall cut off his tail.
'Therefore they shall tie a muzzle to the collar; by the two
sides of the collar they shall tie it. If they shall not do so,
and the mad dog that bites without barking, smite a sheep or
wound a man, he shall pay for the wound of the wounded as for
wilful murder.'
segments.zh:
『若他第五次打擊羊群或傷害人類，他們應割去其尾巴。
『因此他們應將口套綁在項圈上；由項圈的兩側他們應將其綁縛。若他們不這樣做，而無聲咬人的瘋犬打擊羊群或傷害人類，他應如同故意謀殺般為傷者的創傷賠償。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýat ahmi nmâne ýat mâzdayasnôish
spâ ahãm-baodhemnô vâ bavat adhâityô-xratush
kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi mazdayasna,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, avatha hê baêshazem
upôisayen ýatha dahmâicit ashaone.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If there be
in the house of a worshipper of Mazda a mad dog, who has no
scent, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall attend him to heal him, in
the same manner as they would do for one of the faithful.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若馬茲達的信徒之家中有一隻瘋犬，無有嗅覺，馬茲達的信徒應當如何？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『他們應照顧他使其得以痊癒，如同他們對待信徒中的一員一樣。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýezi isemnô nôit viñdâite
kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker oi the material world, thou Holy One! If they try
to heal him and fail, what shall the worshippers of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若他們嘗試為其治療而失敗，馬茲達的信徒應當如何？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ava hê barayen
... frâ-hîmcit nidarezayen ýezi nôit
spâ ahãm-baodhemnô maêkhe vâ câiti
vâ vaêmi vâ urûidhi vâ apô
vâ nâvayå paidhyâite ahmat haca irishyât,
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall put a wooden collar around
his neck, and they shall tie thereto a muzzle, an asti thick if
the wood be hard, two astis thick if it be soft. To that collar
they shall tie it; by the two sides of the collar they shall tie
it.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：『他們應在其頸上套一個木質項圈，並應為其綁縛口套——若木質堅硬則厚一阿希，若為柔軟則厚二阿希。他們應於該項圈為其綁縛；由項圈的兩側他們應將其綁縛。

segments.orig:
ýezi tat paiti irishyeiti ainghat haca shyaothnâvareza
atha bavaiñti peshô-tanvô!
segments.en:
'If they shall not do so, the scentless dog may fall into a
hole, or a well, or a precipice, or a river, or a canal, and come
to grief: if he come to grief so, they shall be therefore
Peshotanus.
 
 VI.
segments.zh: 『若他們不這樣做，無嗅覺之犬可能墜入洞穴、井中、懸崖、河流或運河而遭逢不幸：若他如此遭逢不幸，他們因此應成為佩紹坦努罪。

segments.orig:
spânem dathem zarathushtra
azem ýô ahurô mazdå
hvâvastrem hvâ-aothrem
zaêni-budhrem tizhi-dãsurem vîrô-draonanghem
gaêthanãm harethrâi, adha azem ýô
ahurô mazdå spânem nidathem ýat dim mazaosh
kehrpô tûrahe ýezi asta asha xrathwa ýezi
asta gaêthâbyô.
segments.en:
'The dog, O Spitama Zarathushtra! I, Ahura Mazda, have made
self-clothed and self-shod; watchful and wakeful; and
sharp-toothed; born to take his food from man and to watch over
man's goods. I, Ahura Mazda, have made the dog strong of body
against the evil-doer, when sound of mind and watchful over your
goods.
segments.zh: 『犬也，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，使其自衣自履；警惕而清醒；牙齒銳利；生來以從人類獲取食物並看守人類之物為生。我，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，使犬之身軀強健以對抗惡行者，當其頭腦清健且守護汝等之物時。

segments.orig:
ýasca hê spitama zarathushtra vâcim paiti
zaênish anghat nôit hê tå vîspô
tâyush vâ vehrkô vâ apaiti-busti haca
vîzhibyô para-baraiti, jãthwa vehrka scãthwa
vehrka pôithwa vehrka snaêzhana!
segments.en:
'And whosoever shall awake at his voice, O Spitama
Zarathushtra! neither shall the thief nor the wolf carry anything
from his house, without his being warned; the wolf shall be
smitten and torn to pieces; he is driven away, he melts away like
snow.'
segments.zh: 『凡任何人應在其吠聲中驚醒者，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！盜賊與狼皆不得從其家中攜走任何物，而無警告；狼應被擊中並撕裂；牠被驅趕，牠如雪融般消散。』

segments.orig:
dâtare ... katârô zî ayå vehrkayå
jãthwô-tarô anghen ashâum ahura mazda
ýatha spâ vehrkahe kerenaoiti ýatha ýat
vehrkô spâ, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
aêshô zî aêtayå vehrkayå jãthwô-tarô
anghen ashâum zarathushtra ýatha spâ vehrkahe
kerenaoiti ýatha ýat vehrkô spâ.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Which of the
two wolves deserves more to be killed, the one that a he-dog
begets of a she-wolf, or the one that a he-wolf begets of a
she-dog?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Of these two wolves, the one that a
he-dog begets of a she-wolf deserves more to be killed than the
one that a he-wolf begets of a she-dog.
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！這兩頭狼中，哪一頭更值得被殺死——公狗與母狼生的狼，還是公狼與母狗生的狼？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「這兩頭狼中，公狗與母狼生的狼比公狼與母狗生的狼更值得被殺死。

segments.orig:
ustâcit spâna pateñti pasush-haurvãmca
vish-haurvãmca vohunazgãmca draxtô-hunaranãmca
ýatha-khnyô gaêthâbyô taêcit
ýå bavaiñti aoshô-tarasca duzhitô-tarasca
gaêthô- jatarasca ýatha anya spâ.
segments.en:
'For the dogs born therefrom fall on the shepherd's dog, on
the house-dog, on the Vohu-nazga dog, on the trained dog, and
destroy the folds; such dogs are more murderous, more
mischievous, more destructive to the folds than any other dogs.
segments.zh: 「因為由此生出的狗會襲擊牧羊犬、家犬、沃胡納茲加犬、訓練過的犬，並摧毀羊圈；這樣的狗比任何其他的狗更具殺戮性、更具惡意、對羊圈的破壞性更強。

segments.orig:
ustâcit vehrka pateñti khnyô gaêthâbyô
taêcit ýå bavaiñti aoshô-tarasca
duzhitô-tarasca gaêthô-jatarasca ýatha
anya vehrka!
segments.en:
'And the wolves born therefrom fall on the shepherd's dog,
on the house-dog, on the Vohunazga dog, on the trained dog, and
destroy the folds; such wolves are more murderous, more
mischievous, more destructive to the folds than any other wolves.
 
 VIII.
segments.zh: 「由此生出的狼會襲擊牧羊犬、家犬、沃胡納茲加犬、訓練過的犬，並摧毀羊圈；這樣的狼比任何其他的狼更具殺戮性、更具惡意、對羊圈的破壞性更強。

segments.orig:
sûnahe aêvahe ashtâ bifrem, asti shê
haêm ýatha athaurune asti-shê haêm ýatha
rathaêshtârahe asti-shê haêm ýatha
vâstryehe fshuyañtô asti-shê haêm
ýatha vaêsâush asti shê haêm ýatha
tâyaosh asti-shê haêm ýatha disaosh asti-shê
haêm ýatha jahikayå asti-shê haêm
ýatha aperenâyûkahe.
segments.en:
'A dog has the characters of eight sorts of people:-
'He has the character of a priest,
'He has the character of a warrior,
'He has the character of a husbandman,
'He has the character of a strolling singer,
'He has the character of a thief,
'He has the character of a disu,
'He has the character of a courtezan,
'He has the character of a child.
segments.zh:
「狗具有八類人的特性：
「牠具有祭司的特性，
「牠具有戰士的特性，
「牠具有農民的特性，
「牠具有流浪歌手的特性，
「牠具有盜賊的特性，
「牠具有匪盜的特性，
「牠具有妓女的特性，
「牠具有孩童的特性。

segments.orig:
paiti hvaretha hvaraiti ýatha âthrava huxshnaothrô
ýatha âthrava hvâzârô ýatha
âthrava aêshô kasu draonô ýatha
âthrava aiti-shê haêm ýatha athaurune,
raptô paurvaêibya ýatha rathaêshtå
aipi- jatô gãm hudhånghem ýatha rathaêshtå
parô pasca nmânahe ýatha rathaêshtå
aiti shê haêm ýatha rathaêshtârahe.
segments.en:
'He eats the refuse, like a priest; he is easily
satisfied, like a priest; he is patient, like a priest; he wants
only a small piece of bread, like a priest; in these things he is
like unto a priest.
'He marches in front, like a warrior; he fights for the
beneficent cow, like a warrior; he goes first out of the house,
like a warrior; in these things he is like unto a warrior.
segments.zh:
「牠吃剩食，如同祭司；牠容易滿足，如同祭司；牠有耐心，如同祭司；牠只要一小塊麵包，如同祭司；在這些方面牠就像祭司一樣。
「牠走在前面，如同戰士；牠為了善良的牛而戰鬥，如同戰士；牠首先走出屋子，如同戰士；在這些方面牠就像戰士一樣。

segments.orig:
zaênangha evîspô-hvafna ýatha vâstryô
fshuyãs parô pasca nmânahe ýatha vâstryô
fshuyãs pasca parô nmânahe ýatha vâstryô
fshuyãs aiti-shê haêm ýatha vâstryehe
fshuyañtô, hvañdrakarô ýatha
vaêsô asnaêraêshô ýatha vaêsô
zairimyafsma thryafsma ýatha vaêsô aiti shê
haêm ýatha vaêsâush.
segments.en:
'He is watchful and sleeps lightly, like a husbandman; he
goes first out of the house, like a husbandman; he returns last
into the house, like a husbandman; in these things he is like
unto a husbandman.
'He is fond of singing, like a strolling singer; he wounds
him who gets too near, like a strolling singer; he is
ill-trained, like a strolling singer; he is changeful, like a
strolling singer; in these things he is like unto a strolling
singer.
segments.zh:
「牠警惕而睡眠輕淺，如同農民；牠首先走出屋子，如同農民；牠最後才回到屋子，如同農民；在這些方面牠就像農民一樣。
「牠喜歡唱歌，如同流浪歌手；牠傷害靠得太近的人，如同流浪歌手；牠訓練不足，如同流浪歌手；牠易於改變，如同流浪歌手；在這些方面牠就像流浪歌手一樣。

segments.orig:
tãthrô-cinô ýatha tâyush xshapâyaonô
ýatha tâyush apishma-hvarô ýatha tâyush
athaca duzhnidhâtô ýatha tâyush aiti-
shê haêm ýatha tâyaosh, tãthrô-cinô
ýatha disush xshapâyaonô ýatha disush
apishma-hvarô ýatha disush athaca duzhnidhâtô
ýatha disush aiti-shê haêm ýatha disâush.
segments.en:
'He is fond of darkness, like a thief; he prowls about in
darkness, like a thief; he is a shameless eater, like a thief; he
is therefore an unfaithful keeper, like a thief; in these things
he is like unto a thief.
'He is fond of darkness, like a disu; he prowls about in
darkness, like a disu; he is a shameless eater, like a disu; he
is therefore an unfaithful keeper, like a disu; in these things
he is like unto a disu.
segments.zh:
「牠喜歡黑暗，如同盜賊；牠在黑暗中潛行，如同盜賊；牠是個無恥的食客，如同盜賊；因此牠是個不忠實的守護者，如同盜賊；在這些方面牠就像盜賊一樣。
「牠喜歡黑暗，如同匪盜；牠在黑暗中潛行，如同匪盜；牠是個無恥的食客，如同匪盜；因此牠是個不忠實的守護者，如同匪盜；在這些方面牠就像匪盜一樣。

segments.orig:
hvañdrakarô ýatha jahika asnaêraêshô
ýatha jahika airitô pañtânem ýatha
jahika zairimyafsma thryafsma ýatha jahika aiti-shê
haêm ýatha jahikayå, hvafnô ýatha
aperenâyush snaêzhanô ýatha aperenâyush
hizu-drâjô ýatha aperenâyush pairi-taxtô
paurvaêibya ýatha aperenâyush aiti-shê
haêm ýatha aperenâyûkahe.
segments.en:
'He is fond of singing, like a courtezan; he wounds him who
gets too near, like a courtezan; he roams along the roads, like a
courtezan; he is ill-trained, like a courtezan; he is changeful,
like a courtezan; in these things he is like unto a courtezan.
'He is fond of sleep, like a child; he is tender like snow,
like a child; he is full of tongue, like a child; he digs the
earth with his paws, like a child; in these things he is like
unto a child.
segments.zh:
「牠喜歡唱歌，如同妓女；牠傷害靠得太近的人，如同妓女；牠沿著道路遊蕩，如同妓女；牠訓練不足，如同妓女；牠易於改變，如同妓女；在這些方面牠就像妓女一樣。
「牠喜歡睡眠，如同孩童；牠柔軟如雪，如同孩童；牠舌頭很多，如同孩童；牠用爪子挖掘土地，如同孩童；在這些方面牠就像孩童一樣。

segments.orig:
ýat mê aêshãmcit nmânanãmca
caratô dva mâ apa-raodhayaêta ýasca spâ
pasush-haurvô ýasca spâ vish- haurvô,
nôit mê nmânem vîdhâtô hishteñti
zãm paiti ahuradhâtãm ýezi mê
nôit ånghât spâ pasush-haurvô vâ
vishhaurvô vâ!
segments.en:
'If those two dogs of mine, the shepherd's dog and the
house-dog, pass by any of my houses, let them never be kept away
from it.
'For no house could subsist on the earth made by Ahura, but
for those two dogs of mine, the shepherd's dog and the
house-dog.'
segments.zh:
「若我那兩隻犬，牧羊犬與家犬，經過我任何一所房舍，則它們絕不應被驅趕出去。
「因為在阿胡拉所造的大地上，沒有我那兩隻犬，牧羊犬與家犬，任何房舍都不能存立。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ýat sûnîsh para-irithyeiti
nishtâ-zemanasca pairishtâ-xshudrasca kutha aêshãm
baodhô jasaiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When a dog
dies, with marrow and seed dried up, whereto does his ghost go?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！當一隻犬死亡時，其骨髓與種子已乾涸，其幽靈往何處去？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, xå paiti apãm
parâiti spitama zarathushtra athra ånghãm hãm-bavaiñti
dva udra upâpa hazangrâish sûnîsh strî-
nâmanô hazangrâish sûnîsh nairyô-nâmanô
mithwana strica nairyasca, udrahe avakhnânô haêcô
kerenaoiti ýat avâstrem.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It passes to the spring of the
waters, O Spitama Zarathushtra! and there out of them two
water-dogs are formed: out of every thousand dogs and every
thousand she-dogs, a couple is formed, a water-dog and a water
she-dog.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「它往眾水之泉而去，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！因此從其中生出兩隻水犬：每千隻犬與每千隻母犬中，生出一對，一隻水犬與一隻水母犬。

segments.orig:
para nû ahmât haca asanghatca shôithrâatca
axshtat spitama zarathushtra izhâca âzûitishca
para dasvareca baêshazemca para fradathemca varedathemca
vaxshathemca para ýavanãmca vâstranãmca
uruthem.
segments.en:
'He who kills a water-dog brings about a drought that dries
up pastures.
'Until then, O Spitama Zarathushtra! sweetness and fatness
would flow out from that land and from those fields, with health
and healing, with fulness and increase and growth, and a growing
of corn and grass.'
segments.zh:
「殺死水犬者乃招致旱災，使牧場乾枯。
「至此之前，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊！甘甜與肥膩將從該地與該等田野流出，帶著健康與療癒、帶著豐盈與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的生長。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... kadha-nô ahmâi asanghaêca
shôithraêca paiti-jasâtô izhâca
âzûitishca kadha dasvareca baêshazemca kadha
fradathemca varedathemca vaxshathemca kadha ýavanãmca
vâstranãmca uruthem.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! When are
sweetness and fatness to come back again to that land and to
those fields, with health and healing, with fulness and increase
and growth, and a growing of corn and grass?
54, 55. Ahura Mazda answered: 'Sweetness and fatness will never
come back again to that land and to those fields, with health and
healing, with fulness and increase and growth, and a growing of
corn and grass, until the murderer of the water-dog has been
smitten to death on the spot, and the holy soul of the dog has
been offered up a sacrifice, for three days and three nights,
with fire blazing, with Baresma tied up, and with Haoma
prepared.
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！甘甜與肥膩何時將再度回歸該地與該等田野，帶著健康與療癒、帶著豐盈與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的生長？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「甘甜與肥膩絕不將再度回歸該地與該等田野，帶著健康與療癒、帶著豐盈與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的生長，直到水犬的兇手在現場被擊殺，且犬之聖靈於三日三夜間，以熾烈的火、綁定的巴雷斯瑪與備妥的豪麻獻祭。」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, nôit nû
para ahmât spitama zarathushtra asanghaêca shôithrâica
paiti-jasâtô izhâca âzûitishca nôit
dasvareca baêshazemca nôit fradathemca varedathemca
vaxshathemca nôit ýavanãmca vâstranãmca
uruthem.

para ahmât ýat idha udra-janô hathra jatô
nijanâite ýat vâ aêtahe udrahe upa dahmem
urvânem frâyazåñte thri-ayarem thri-xshaparem
saociñtat paiti âthrat frasteretât paiti baresmen
uzdâtât paiti haomât.

pascaêta ahmâi asanghaêca shôithraêca
paiti-jasâtô izhâca âzûitishca pascaêta
dasvareca baêshazemca pascaêta fradathemca varedathemca
vaxshathemca pascaêta ýavanãmca vâstranãmca
uruthem! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
['Then sweetness and fatness will come back again to that
land and to those fields, with health and healing, with fulness
and increase and growth, and a growing of corn and grass.']
segments.zh: 〔如是則甘甜與肥膩將再度回歸該地與該等田野，帶著健康與療癒、帶著豐盈與增長與成長，以及穀物與草的生長。〕
